statement_record.book: A co-design diagram is a box-and-wire picture of a design problem: every wire is labelled by a PREORDER of resources of one type (ordered less-useful to more-useful), every box is a design component whose LEFT ports carry the resources it produces and whose RIGHT ports carry the resources it requires, each wire joining a requirement to a production is annotated with ≤, and the composite outer box is again such a component. Made precise later: each box denotes a feasibility relation (Def 4.2), the whole diagram a composite in a compact closed category.
statement_record.intree: Inductive CTerm : list Colour -> list Colour -> Type := CT_id | CT_braid | CT_comp | CT_tens | CT_gen; Program Definition CFreeCat : Category := {| obj := list Colour; hom := @CTerm Colour S |}; Theorem cinterp_unique : ∀ cs ds (t : CTerm S cs ds), fmap[G] t ≈ hom_cast … (cinterp P S v t).
statement_record.strength_comparison: intree-weaker: the library formalizes only the GENERIC box-and-wire syntax — terms with an ordered list of coloured input wires and output wires, built from identity wires, braids, sequential composition CT_comp, parallel composition CT_tens and signature generators, assembled into a category CFreeCat and interpreted into any strict symmetric monoidal target by a unique functor. None of the co-design reading survives: colours are elements of an arbitrary Type, never preorders of resources; generators come from an arbitrary signature, never feasibility relations; ports have no produces/requires polarity; there is no ≤ annotation attached to a wire; and there is no semantic target (Feas) to interpret a co-design diagram into.

statement_record.book: For preorders X = (X, ≤_X) and Y = (Y, ≤_Y), a feasibility relation for X given Y, written Φ : X ⇸ Y, is a MONOTONE MAP Φ : X^op × Y → Bool; Φ(x,y) = true reads 'x can be obtained given y', and monotonicity on the product preorder says x' ≤_X x and y ≤_Y y' imply Φ(x,y) ≤_Bool Φ(x',y'). statement_record.book: Let V = (V, ≤, I, ⊗) be a unital commutative quantale and X, Y be V-categories. A V-profunctor from X to Y, written Φ : X ⇸ Y, is a V-FUNCTOR Φ : X^op × Y → V, where the product is the enriched product of V-categories and V is regarded as enriched in itself. Feasibility relations are the case V = Bool.
